messages:
Maya Lee: manager ping  has an IC -> Senior IC promo (effective 2026-04-01) for an employee relocating from SG -> US later April. they asked: what evidence do we need, who signs off on retro, and can we show an estimated USD number before calibration?
Oscar Nguyen: short: Promo Evidence form + 1-page bullets mapping to rubric axes, 2 manager statements, links to dashboards/PRs. For currency: file comp-change in local currency of payroll at the time of processing (SGD now, USD after move). Provide USD equivalents as estimates.
Felix Turner: retro owners: comp-ops approves level and retro window; payroll calculates amounts. Retro > $10k or lookback >120 days requires Director signoff. If relocation spans jurisdictions, payroll splits retro across jurisdictions.
CompOps: calibration can provide a provisional estimate labeled "pending calibration". Use language: "Estimated base: USD X-Yk (subject to calibration and approval)." Avoid guarantees.
Maya Lee: manager also worries about bonus proration and equity timing after relocation. any standard rules?
Oscar Nguyen: base change prorat-ed from effective date. Annual bonus proration follows the plan for that jurisdiction; equity grants are separate requests (submit option-grant form). If move changes tax residence before payout, tax withholding will follow new residency rules.
Felix Turner: timeline note: submit Promo Evidence + comp-change 2 weeks before effective date to hit payroll cutoff. Late submissions may push retro into future payroll cycles. Payroll cutoff for US is 15th for next-month pay runs.
hr-bot: Promo Evidence template v2 uploaded to #people-ops-resources (doc T-2098).
Maya Lee: can we get a simple pasteable checklist for managers?
CompOps: paste this in Workday or the email:
```
- Attach Promo Evidence form (1-page bullets mapping to rubric)+ 2 manager statements
- Add before/after role bullets + 1-line org chart snippet
- Submit comp-change in current payroll currency and include USD equivalent
- Include estimated retro amount (USD) and reason for delay if any
- Confirm employee has uploaded local tax/KYC docs
- If relocation planned, note anticipated move date and local payroll change
- Tag @CompOps and @payroll in ticket; request provisional estimate if needed
```
Maya Lee: perfect. last Q: how do we phrase communication to the employee while calibration is pending?
CompOps: suggested message: "Your manager has submitted a promotion packet. Compensation details are provisional until calibration and approvals complete. We expect an update by [date]." Keep it short and internal-pending.
Felix Turner: ping payroll early if relocation + retro span countries — that usually needs manual split and takes longer.
Maya Lee: thanks team, i'll send checklist to the manager and ask them to include USD estimate. :pray:
